title: Rotate a Grayscale Image Clockwise
prompt: An image utility receives a nonempty rectangular 2D list of integer pixels. Implement `rotate_clockwise(image)` and return a new 2D list representing the image rotated 90 degrees clockwise. An H by W image becomes W by H. Leave the input unchanged. Python built-ins and NumPy may be used, but `np.rot90` may not be used.

example.reasoning: The two input rows become three output rows after a clockwise turn.
